tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Set up any game to play in this chat: board games, card games, dice games, word and guessing games, mysteries. Describe it with the building blocks below, or pass starter for a ready one (tic-tac-toe, four-in-a-row, gomoku, checkers, reversi, crazy-eights, go-fish, twenty-one, pig, sea-battle, hangm

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: What your seat can see now: the board, your hand, public piles, scores, dice, secrets you hold and the recent log. Call it when the player says they've moved or it might be your turn.

tools.name: take_turn
tools.description:
Apply one or more actions for your seat, all or nothing: if any action is illegal, none happen and you get the reason. Usually end with end_turn. Action types and fields:
- place {at: "B3"} or {column: "D"} with gravity; optional label, shape (disc, square, ring, star, diamond), color, kind, owner

tools.name: show_board
tools.description: Show the interactive board in the chat again, for example after a long conversation or when the player asks to see it.

tools.name: delete_game
tools.description: Delete a game for good: the board, cards, log, secrets, seats and keys, and Playtable's record of it. Its link stops working. Only call this when the player asks. It needs the delete_code from the board in the chat where the game was made; you never get that code yourself, so ask the player to paste

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: With a pro_code, says if the code is good. With no code, says which games Playtable Pro adds, what it costs and where to get it. Nothing is bought through this tool. Every other game, and any game you make up, is free.

tools.name: join_game
tools.description: Join a game a friend made, from this chat. Use it when the player pastes a line like "Join my Playtable game: game_id ...". tools.name: daily_challenge
tools.description: Today's word puzzle, the same for everyone: a five letter word in 6 tries. The server picks the word and checks each guess, so you never see it until the round ends. Call with no guess to start, then pass the player's guess with the round_id. Free, with a day streak: pass streak_key (st_...) if the

tools.name: weekly_game
tools.description: Playtable Club adds a new game every Monday. This sets up this week's (or an earlier one by key) for a player with a Club code, saved under the code. Without key it lists this week's game. Seats can be changed the same way as create_game, for example two human seats to play a friend.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_game" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
